description:
Clip the global Natural Earth physical raster to the boundary of Bolivia.

1. Load the raster layer: `~/gvsig_data/raster/NE1_HR_LC_SR_W_DR.tif`
2. Load the vector layer: `~/gvsig_data/countries/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp`
3. Select 'Bolivia' in the countries layer.
4. Open the Geoprocessing Toolbox (Geoprocess -> Toolbox) and find the 'Clip grid with polygon layer' tool (or similar raster clipping tool).
5. Configure the tool to clip the raster using the selected Bolivia polygon.
6. Save the result as a TIFF file to `~/gvsig_data/exports/bolivia_relief.tif`.

The output file must contain only the raster data covering Bolivia.
